description: Java class implementing an adapter for mapping acknowledgements to and from an adaptable form within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles conversion between internal acknowledgement representations and external protocol payload/headers.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsAdapter
classes.description: Final class that implements the Adapter interface for converting a collection of acknowledgements to and from an Adaptable representation, based on the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method returning an instance of AcknowledgementsAdapter configured with a specific HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an Acknowledgements instance by extracting payload and headers.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts Acknowledgements to an Adaptable instance for transmission, setting payload and headers accordingly.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath groups this adapter is associated with; in this case, 'THINGS'.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of channels this adapter supports, specifically 'TWIN' and 'LIVE'.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria for topic matching, in this case 'ACKS'.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions supported; here, none are supported.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is intended for protocol responses; true in this case.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter requires a subject; false here.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Builds a TopicPath for acknowledgements based on the entity ID and channel.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Generates a Payload object from acknowledgements, including status and acknowledgement details.

methods.name: getPayloadValue
methods.description: Creates a JSON object containing acknowledgement data for the payload.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutLabel
methods.description: Builds a JSON representation of an acknowledgement, excluding its label.

methods.name: getExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts internal Ditto headers to external headers, ensuring content type headers are included.
